tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
US, China, and the European Union are taking different paths to regulate artificial intelligence, with new rules addressing safety, children, and economic impact. That's confirmed by Macau Business.
Tencent Music has integrated DeepSeek into its streaming service. Now parent company Tencent is among the biggest backers of the artificial intelligence company's $12B+ funding round, still open per Music Business Worldwide.
China's open artificial intelligence models are gaining global users. But developers are losing revenue to third parties, confirmed by South China Morning Post.
OpenAI has shared artificial intelligence solved math results, including progress on three Millennium Prize Problems. That's confirmed by FAZ.
Mistral has launched a 1-trillion-parameter Large 4 model with a public preview and open-weight release planned by month-end, confirmed by LatestLY.
Free every hour.
